paragraphs.source_en: This is a cowardly world: it cannot tolerate love, it cannot tolerate love! Let your full head of hair fall loose, bare your two feet; Come with me, my love, cast off this world and die for our love! I take your hand, love, you follow me; Let the thorns pierce through the soles of our feet, let the hail split open our heads; you follow me, I take your hand, we escape the cage and recover our freedom! Come with me, my love! The human world has already fallen behind our backs, -- look, is this not the vast white sea? The vast white sea, the vast white sea, boundless freedom, I and you and love! Look along my finger, that tiny star of blue at the edge of the sky -- that is an island; on the island there is green grass, fresh flowers, beautiful beasts and birds; Quick, board this nimble little boat, go to that ideal heaven -- love, joy, freedom -- farewell to the human world, forever! Composed in February 1925

paragraphs.source_zh:
這是一個懦怯的世界：

容不得戀愛，容不得戀愛！

披散你的滿頭髮，

赤露你的一雙腳；

跟著我來，我的戀愛，

拋棄這個世界

殉我們的戀愛！

我拉著你的手，

愛，你跟著我走；

聽憑荊棘把我們的腳心刺透，

聽憑冰雹劈破我們的頭，

你跟著我走，

我拉著你的手，

逃出了牢籠，恢復我們的自由！

跟著我來，

我的戀愛！

人間已經掉落在我們的後背，──

看呀，這不是白茫茫的大海？

白茫茫的大海，

白茫茫的大海，

無邊的自由，我與你與戀愛！

順著我的指頭看，

那天邊一小星的藍──

那是一座島，島上有青草，

鮮花，美麗的走獸與飛鳥；

快上這輕快的小艇，

去到那理想的天庭──

戀愛，歡欣，自由──辭別了人間，永遠！

一九二五年二月作
